analysis_notes: This analysis is based on repository structure and documentation rather than GitHub issues, as no issues exist yet in the uml-codex repository. The project appears to be in an early research phase, systematically analyzing open source projects related to regulatory reporting, domain modeling, and workflow engines. The knowledge store structure suggests a methodical approach to learning from existing solutions before building custom tooling. Key focus areas include DSL design, code generation, domain modeling (particularly ISDA CDM), and workflow orchestration.
